terms.Agreement: The Bookkeeping and Payroll Services Agreement between the parties dated 1 December 2026
terms.Categories of Data Subjects: Customer's employees and the contact persons at Customer's customers and suppliers
terms.Categories of Personal Data: Names, contact details, personal identity numbers, salary and tax details, bank account numbers for salary payments, and invoice details
terms.Special Category Data: Sick leave records that show an employee was absent through illness (data concerning health)
terms.Special Category Data Restrictions or Sa: Only the two payroll staff named in Provider's access list can see sick leave records; they are kept apart from other payroll data and deleted 24 months after the payroll month.
terms.Frequency of Transfer: Continuous, as Customer uploads documents and runs payroll each month
terms.Nature and Purpose of Processing: Bookkeeping, monthly payroll and statutory reporting to the Swedish Tax Agency on Customer's behalf
terms.Duration of Processing: For the term of the Agreement and until the data is returned or deleted under Section 7
Security Policy: Staff who process Customer Personal Data are bound by a written duty of confidentiality and are trained in data protection each year.
Access by named account with two-factor sign-in; payroll data only for payroll staff.
Data encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2 or later) and at rest; nightly backups kept in Sweden for 35 days.
Personal data breaches handled under Provider's written incident routine, reviewed each year.
Approved Subprocessors: Nordmoln Hosting AB, Sweden: hosting of the bookkeeping system
Lönebyrån Systems AB, Sweden: the payroll software and its support

_note: The Governing Member State (the law and courts for the EEA SCCs) is the parties' choice: ask the person, never fill it in.
